issue.title: Remove CompletableContext and replace it with StepListener

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
These two mostly do the same, making `CompletableContext` and the compatibility layer between the context and `ActionListener` redundant.
Removing it here to in part to set up a clean solution for #77999.

issue.title: Fix fransport handshake starting before tls handshake completes

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Implements waiting for the TLS handshake to complete before triggering the connected callback and thus the transport handshake.
Had to make copies of two transport test cases with slight but not trivial alterations to force a tls handshake before doing either a timeout or a connection reset. Will dry that up in a follow-up as it's a bit a noisy refactoring.

closes #77999
